_note: GET /api/overview from S1 seed 1 variant peak, policy agent, captured at sim minute 1245 (20:45 IST) with the incident open. Whole arrays, nothing truncated. Produced by scripts/capture_board_fixture.py, which stops the world at the cutoff by deleting every simulator row dated at or after it. The ledger still references orders that were deleted, so this database is a board fixture and not an evaluation input. No number in docs/RESULTS.md comes from here.

sample_descriptions: You have exceeded the transaction limit on your card.
Payment was not completed on time.
Payment failed due to a technical error at bank. Try another method.
Your payment could not be processed using the UPI ID entered.
Your payment was declined. Please try again.

diagnosis.rationale: The `error_source` is dominated by `bank` (0.409) and `issuer_bank` (0.409), significantly above baselines. The `error_step` `payment_debit_request` is highly elevated at 0.636. Crucially, `sibling_segments` like okicici and oksbi are healthy, isolating the issue to `upi:upi_handle:okhdfcbank` and indicating an issuer outage.
diagnosis.rules_detail: segment is a single upi_handle, dominant source issuer_bank at 0.41, 3 sibling(s) all healthy

plan.rationale: The issuer is experiencing an outage. We will steer customers away from the failing UPI handle and provide recovery links to consented customers who have alternate payment methods available, allowing them to complete their payments.
